services.name: API Gateway
services.description: Entry point for all external and internal API requests. Handles rate limiting, routing, and auth token forwarding.

services.name: Auth Service
services.description: Issues and validates JWT tokens. Manages signing keys and RBAC permissions.

services.name: Trade Service
services.description: Core trading logic — validates, enriches, and routes trade orders. Orchestrates calls to risk, settlement, and order-gateway.

services.name: Order Gateway
services.description: Validates and submits orders to the matching engine. Enforces pre-trade risk checks and reference data validation.

services.name: Risk Engine
services.description: Real-time position and exposure management. Calculates VaR, margin requirements, and breach alerts.

services.name: Market Data Feed
services.description: Ingests real-time price ticks from upstream providers. Normalises and broadcasts to internal consumers.

services.name: Price Engine
services.description: Calculates theoretical prices, checks staleness thresholds, and disseminates validated prices to consumers.

services.name: Settlement Service
services.description: Processes post-trade settlement — confirms, nets, and books completed trades into ledger.

services.name: Market Data Consumer
services.description: Subscribes to market-data-feed, caches prices, and provides them to downstream services on demand.

services.name: Reference Data Service
services.description: Manages static reference data — instruments, counterparties, legal entities, and margin tables.
